steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Change the initial event type to Auction; the catalog has no forward/sell direction control.
Select the first available auction template; a forward-specific template cannot be selected by a confirmed name.
Add the requested product as the first line item.
Enter the decimal quantity in the pricing sheet and press Tab as the case requires.
Assert that the sheet kept the decimal value; rounding or refusal alternatives cannot be represented in one assertion.
Add one available QA vendor so the event can be published.
Attempt to publish the configured auction after the quantity check.
